correctness.rationale: Exact square Kolmogorov products in irreducible finite chain force alpha_i beta_{i->j}=alpha_j beta_{j->i}. Symmetric t_ij=beta_{i->j}/alpha_j then imply t_ki=t_kj for every positive edge ij and distinct k, producing precisely disjoint uniform-weight clique components (including isolated vertices). Conversely the explicit positive configuration weight has ratio infection-rate/recovery-rate for every allowed flip, so detailed balance and the factorized Z follow. The minimal 3-path has unequal four-state products for all alpha,beta>0. An exact rational checker exhaustively confirms all 1,099 uniform graphs through n=5, 18,801 tested squares (stopping on first failure), and 192 weighted six-site state-edge equations. The unrestricted result is analytic, not extrapolated from experiments; non-reversibility does not mean no stationary distribution.

value.rationale: The result identifies the exact structural and rate boundary between equilibrium-like reversible epidemic dynamics and nonequilibrium stationary circulation for a biologically standard additive infection mechanism, rather than one more small simulation. It characterizes all positive immigration/recovery heterogeneities and directed weighted transmissions and yields a polynomial-time exact stationary normalizer. A single missing link in a connected positive uniform contact network forces irreversibility already on a 3-path, clarifying why complete-graph formulas cannot be ported to arbitrary networks. This constitutes a motivated structural classification; it does not equate reversibility with stationarity or claim the underlying cycle criterion is new.
